name: Commure
description: Commure is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Commure is a privately held healthcare technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $70 million round announced on May 19, 2026, valued the company at $7 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in Mountain View, California, Commure develops AI software that health systems and physician practices use to automate billing and other revenue cycle work and to document patient visits. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round; the May 2026 figure is post-money, as announced by the company. Commure did not announce its 2021 financing, which Business Insider reported as $500 million raised across two rounds, and the October 2023 amount is as reported by Endpoints News.
round_notes: General Catalyst led the May 2026 round. In June 2025, Commure also announced $200 million of growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund, which provides capital in exchange for a capped share of future revenue rather than equity; it is therefore not shown as a round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: General Catalyst led the May 2026 round, with participation from Sequoia Capital, Morgan Stanley and Kirkland & Ellis, and provided the new capital that accompanied Commure's merger with Athelas in October 2023. Human Capital and Greenoaks Capital led the 2021 Series D. Other investors include Lux Capital, 8VC and Elad Gil.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Commure appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Commure's May 2026 announcement and its announcement of the Athelas merger (October 4, 2023); Athelas's merger announcement (October 2023); reports by Fortune (September 2021), citing Business Insider, HLTH (May 2026) and Endpoints News (October 2023); and SEC Form D filings.
